meta_description: The Tree Man Sheffield offers professional tree surgery, crown reduction, felling and stump removal. Fully insured, same-day quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborist — Safe, Professional Tree Care
hero_subhead: Overgrown branches damaging your property? We safely fell, trim and remove trees across Sheffield — fully insured, same-day site visits.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: From crown reduction to emergency felling, we handle every aspect of tree care with safety and precision.

services.title: Tree Felling
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of diseased, dead or hazardous trees. We handle difficult access and ensure minimal disruption to your garden and neighbours.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Thin out overgrown crowns to restore shape, improve light and reduce wind damage. Promotes healthy regrowth and protects your property.

services.title: Stump Removal & Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump extraction or grinding below ground level. Clears space for replanting or new landscaping without the mess.

services.title: Emergency Tree Work
services.desc: Storm damage, fallen branches or hazardous limbs? We respond 24/7 to make your property safe and clear debris quickly.

services.title: Tree Surveys & Reports
services.desc: Professional assessment of tree health, safety concerns and risk. Written reports for insurance claims, planning applications or peace of mind.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular cutting, shaping and overgrowth removal keeps hedges neat, strong and within boundary lines. Seasonal schedules available.

about_pullquote: I believe in doing the job right first time, with no shortcuts and no mess left behind.
about_para_1: The Tree Man has been caring for Sheffield's gardens, parks and properties for over 18 years. We started with one van and a passion for safe, skilled arboriculture — and we've grown to become the neighbourhood's first choice for tree work. Every member of the team is trained in modern cutting techniques and safety protocols.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we turn up on time, finish cleanly, and explain every step along the way. We're not the cheapest, but we're the most careful. Whether you need a one-off crown reduction or regular hedge maintenance, you'll work with people who genuinely care about your trees and your home.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak taking over half the garden. The Tree Man gave a detailed quote, explained the risks, and felled it safely in just one day. Left the site spotless. Couldn't fault them. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Storm knocked a big branch onto our garage roof. Called them at 9pm on a Saturday, they were here by 11am next morning. Made the area safe, tidied everything up, and helped with our insurance claim. Proper professionals.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Used them for hedge trimming twice now. Punctual, skilled, and they leave zero mess. Not the cheapest quote I got, but worth every penny for the quality and reliability. Will be using them again.
reviews.author: Robert T.
